documents.text: Spain and another in North Africa. It was variously hellenized as "Ábdēra" (), "Ábdēron" (), and "Ábdēros" () before being latinized as "Abdera". (Unusually, it was declined as a 2nd-declension masculine noun despite having a terminal "a".) Greek legend attributed the name to an eponymous "Abderus" who fell nearby and was memorialized by Hercules's founding of a city at the location. The present-day town is written Avdira () and pronounced in modern Greek.
